QuestInfo.name: [Home] Housewarming Party Prep
QuestInfo.0:
To repay Trudy's kindness, you've decided to throw a housewarming party and invite all your neighbors.

Talk to Alvin to prepare for the party.
QuestInfo.1:
Alvin said he was going to gift you a table for your housewarming party..

While you're waiting on that, why not stop by Miranda's shop and pick up some decorations for your home?
QuestInfo.2: Buy some decorations at Miranda's shop!

npc.0: Find Miranda near the fountain in Town Square.
